problem_statement: The paper frames the task as optimizing credit score cards by choosing thresholds and weights so that banks can better predict credit risk and maximize total revenue. It treats this as a combinatorial optimization problem over many credit score card and threshold combinations.
problem_statement_quotes: The optimization algorithm of the quantum computer can better find the correlation between the different factors in the credit score card, so as to better predict the credit risk.
By establishing a multivariate nonlinear integer programming model and transforming it into a QUBO model [1], the bank credit score card is combined optimized to maximize the total bank revenue.
